response.sql:
WITH scope_counts AS (
  SELECT u.acctscope, COUNT(*) AS risk_margin_count
  FROM riskandmargin AS r
  JOIN orders AS o ON o.recordvault = r.ordervault
  JOIN users AS u ON u.userstamp = o.userlink
  GROUP BY u.acctscope
)
SELECT acctscope AS scope,
       risk_margin_count,
       risk_margin_count::numeric / SUM(risk_margin_count) OVER () AS fraction_of_total,
       risk_margin_count::numeric / AVG(risk_margin_count) OVER () AS divided_by_scope_average
FROM scope_counts;

assumptions.assumption: A NULL acctscope is included as its own group and contributes to the total and average across scopes.

alternatives.interpretation: Exclude users whose account scope is NULL from the results and from both calculations.

  GROUP BY u.acctscope
)
SELECT acctscope AS scope,
       risk_margin_count,
       risk_margin_count::numeric / SUM(risk_margin_count) OVER () AS fraction_of_total,
       risk_margin_count::numeric / AVG(risk_margin_count) OVER () AS divided_by_scope_average
FROM scope_counts;
